completion: Filter out the non-monetary losses (except the opportunity costs of the cashflow interests in equity positions): - lost time → opportunity cost - loss of reputation → opportunity cost - fines or (monetary) penalties → money - lost revenue → monetary - foregone revenues → opportunity cost - contract non-renewals → no losses on revenue side, may lose future opportunity profits 3. Define and compute the opportunity cost When a company faces an economic loss, it is: * tangible if it is directly/indirectly reducible to money/revenue figures or money equivalents such as cost savings or purchasing opportunities. * intangible if it is only indirectly measurable through reputation damage and future opportunity costs. Define the opportunity cost based on the company size and the market it operates in.
